DUPLICATE responsibility - TypeScript discovery is bypassed
defectRationale: Violates separation of concerns - two services scanning same files
Duplicates TypeScript discovery responsibility in Python
Creates potential for evidence drift if TypeScript and Python disagree
Python becomes dependent on repository filesystem structure
Breaks architectural boundary defined in M2.9 specification

rationale: Local implementation is the M2.9 REMEDIATION that fixes the identified defect
GitHub implementation contains the ORIGINAL DEFECT (direct filesystem scanning)
This is not a case of divergent valid work - this is remediated vs. unmediated
Local branch represents the correct architectural boundary
GitHub branch represents the violation that M2.9 was created to fix

localAdvantages: Single source of truth for repository evidence (TypeScript)
Enables TypeScript discovery to evolve independently
FastAPI becomes pure evidence consumer (correct role)
Explicit deprecation of old patterns prevents regression
githubDisadvantages: Risk of evidence inconsistency between TypeScript and Python
Couples Python to repository filesystem structure
Represents the exact M2.9 defect pattern
